member.name: T:Application.Interfaces.Common.IFileStorageService
member.summary: Abstraction over "where attachment bytes physically live". Everything upstream (AttachmentController, AttachmentService/DB metadata) only ever deals with the GUID/Path/URL this returns - none of it knows the storage is local disk today. Swapping to S3/Blob later means implementing this interface again, not touching every caller.
